scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @cellab/web" "npm run dev -w @cellab/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cellab/web && npm run build -w @cellab/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cellab/web && npm run typecheck -w @cellab/api
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts -w @cellab/api && npm run check:encoding
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
